account.description: One account: its account_hash (from list_accounts), the last 3 or more digits of its number (135 or ...135), its store ref (A1) or its nickname; every account when left out.

from.description: The first New York date, YYYY-MM-DD; 90 days before to when left out.

to.description: The last New York date, YYYY-MM-DD, included; today when left out, or when later than today.

categories.description: Only these categories of the local history's ledger; every category when left out.

types.description: Only these of Schwab's transaction types, such as TRADE or DIVIDEND_OR_INTEREST (schwab://reference/transaction-types lists them); every type when left out. The local history's rows of History files, which have no type, are then left out.

symbol.description: Only the rows of this symbol, in any case: a security leg's, or a dividend's after the ~ of its description.

source.description: Where to read each account from: auto (the default: the local history when it holds every asked day, else Schwab), store or schwab.

include_uncounted.description: Also list the local history's rows that it does not count (held out, uncertain, linked to an API row), with counted false; totals stay of the counted rows.

detail.description: compact (the default) or full, which adds each row's legs, settlement date, order ID and the local history's pairing.

limit.description: The most rows of a page, 1 to 200; 50 when left out. A page also stops at about 20,000 bytes.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with the same other arguments.
